description_en: Retrieves the details of a resource access request for the specified process instance ID
description_zh: 查询指定流程实例ID下的资源权限申请内容
name: GetApplicationContents

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval process instance for the request
parameters.help_zh: 发起申请的审批流程实例ID
parameters.name: process_instance_id

Data.description_en: The process instance and the associated request details
Data.description_zh: 流程实例与关联的申请内容

ApplicationTime.description_en: The time when the request was submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ApplicationTime.description_zh: 申请发起时间，毫秒时间戳

items.description_en: The details of the request item

AccessTypes.description_en:
The list of requested permissions.

Note: Different levels of resources support different types of permission requests, which are uniformly constrained by ResourceSchema (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).isValidLeaf, accessTypeRestrictions, and authMethodAccessTypes.

Appendix: ResourceSchema documentation for the international site (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)
AccessTypes.description_zh:
申请的权限列表。

注意：不同层级资源支持权限的申请类型不同，统一受ResourceSchema (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).isValidLeaf和accessTypeRestrictions和authMethodAccessTypes 约束。

附：ResourceSchema国际站说明文档 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)

AuthMethod.description_en:
The authorization method. Currently, only SEVERLESS_STARROCKS supports specifying the authorization method: ranger and starrocksManager.

Note: Different resources support different authorization methods, which are uniformly constrained by ResourceSchema (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).authMethods.

Appendix: ResourceSchema documentation for the international site (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)
AuthMethod.description_zh:
授权方式。当前只有SEVERLESS_STARROCKS支持指定授权方式：ranger、starrocksManager。

注意：不同资源支持的授权方式不同，统一受ResourceSchema (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).authMethods 约束。

附：ResourceSchema国际站说明文档 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)

CreateTime.description_zh:
创建时间

格式为 13 位数字，例如 `1773972024000`

ExpirationTime.description_en: The expiration date of the permission. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ExpirationTime.description_zh: 权限截止日期，毫秒时间戳

FinalAccessTypes.description_en: The list of resource operation permissions that are finally approved
FinalAccessTypes.description_zh: 最终审批通过的资源操作权限列表

Grantee.description_en:
The description of the authorization principal. 

Note: The authorization principal types supported by the system are constrained by ResourceSchema (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).authPrincipal.

Appendix: ResourceSchema documentation for the international site (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)

PrincipalId.description_en:
The authorization principal ID. The mapped ID has different semantics for different principal types:

RamUser: the DataWorks user ID.

RamRole: the DataWorks user ID starting with "ROLE_".

DlfRole: the DlfNext role name
PrincipalId.description_zh:
授权主体ID，不同主授权主体类型映射ID具有不同语义：

RamUser：Dataworks UserId

RamRole  "ROLE_"开头的Dataworks UserId

DlfRole: DlfNext 角色名称

PrincipalType.description_en:
The authorization principal type. Valid values:

RamUser
RamRole
DlfRole
PrincipalType.description_zh:
授权主体类型。枚举：

RamUser
RamRole
DlfRole

MetaData.description_en:
The resource metadata declaration.

Note: The metadata is constrained by ResourceSchema (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).resources. A valid resource declaration must include the full-path metadata declaration from level 0 to the validLeaf level.

Appendix: ResourceSchema documentation for the international site (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)
MetaData.description_zh:
资源元数据声明。

注意：元数据受 ResourceSchema (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).resources 约束，有效的资源声明需要包含level 0到validLeaf层的全路径元数据声明。

附：ResourceSchema国际站说明文档 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)

ResourceName.description_en:

Status.description_en:
The approval status. Valid values:

WaitApproval: pending approval
Confirmed: pending authorization
RejectApproval: approval rejected
AuthorizeSucceed: authorization succeeded
AuthorizeFailed: authorization failed
Deleted: deleted
Canceled: canceled
Status.description_zh:
审批状态筛选。枚举：

WaitApproval 待审批
Confirmed 待授权
RejectApproval 审批拒绝
AuthorizeSucceed 授权成功
AuthorizeFailed 授权失败
Deleted 已删除
Canceled 已撤回
